identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Plus Chemotherapy vs. Placebo Plus Chemotherapy for Previously Untreated Locally Recurrent Inoperable or Metastatic Triple Negative Breast Cancer (MK-3475-355/KEYNOTE-355)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Phase III Study of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Plus Chemotherapy vs Placebo Plus Chemotherapy for Previously Untreated Locally Recurrent Inoperable or Metastatic Triple Negative Breast Cancer - (KEYNOTE-355)

armGroups.label: Part 1: Pembrolizumab + Nab-paclitaxel
armGroups.description: Participants receive pembrolizumab 200 mg intravenously (IV) on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle PLUS nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m\^2 IV on Days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle.

armGroups.label: Part 1: Pembrolizumab + Paclitaxel
armGroups.description: Participants receive pembrolizumab 200 mg IV on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle PLUS paclitaxel 90 mg/m\^2 IV on Days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle.

armGroups.label: Part 1: Pembrolizumab + Gemcitabine/Carboplatin
armGroups.description: Participants receive pembrolizumab 200 mg IV on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle PLUS gemcitabine/carboplatin 1000 mg/m\^2 (gemcitabine) and an Area Under the Curve (AUC) 2 (carboplatin) on Days 1 and 8 of each 21-day cycle.

armGroups.label: Part 2: Pembrolizumab + Chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Participants receive pembrolizumab 200 mg IV on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle PLUS one of three background chemotherapy regimens at investigator's discretion: 1) nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m\^2 IV on Days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle, 2) paclitaxel 90 mg/m\^2 IV on Days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle, OR 3) gemcitabine/carboplatin 1000 mg/m\^2 (gemcitabine) and an AUC 2 (carboplatin) on Days 1 and 8 of each 21-day cycle.

armGroups.label: Part 2: Placebo + Chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Participants receive placebo (normal saline) IV on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle PLUS one of three background chemotherapy regimens at investigator's discretion: 1) nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m\^2 IV on Days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle, 2) paclitaxel 90 mg/m\^2 IV on Days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle, OR 3) gemcitabine/carboplatin 1000 mg/m\^2 (gemcitabine) and an AUC 2 (carboplatin) on Days 1 and 8 of each 21-day cycle.
